newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress OKs $424 mln for debt arrears.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress OKs $424 mln for debt arrears.

text.p: Venezuela's Congress approved a government request to spend 200.277 billion bolivars ($424 million) to make overdue debt principal and interest payments from 1994 and 1995, legislators said.
The debt payments approved by a joint session of Congress include 39.378 billion bolivars ($83 million) for foreign debt.
The payments are to be funded from revenues raised by a recent issue of 650 million marks worth of Eurobonds.
Of the $83 million set aside for foreign debt, $75 million is for principal and $8 million for interest payments.
Of the 160.879 billion bolivars set aside for domestic debt, 106.940 billion is principal and 53.939 is interest payments.
